tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't pay anything, because Fjord Analytics has two approved invoices and your request refers to only one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30414 | $2,006.67 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-72044 | $7,969.82 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Their other two invoices aren't payable: INV-30530 is already paid, and INV-56991 is a draft still waiting for approval. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so there's no risk of a duplicate.

Payments are hard to reverse, so I didn't want to guess. Which one should I pay: INV-30414, INV-72044, or both? Both are under the $10,000 limit, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire (or by ACH if wires aren't available), use a unique key so it can't go through twice, and tell you the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-72044, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-72044, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-72044 by wire, and it went through once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-72044 (Fjord Analytics), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $7,969.82, the full invoice amount
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent

The operating account's payment list now shows only this one payment, so nothing was paid twice. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. I didn't touch INV-30414 ($2,006.67, due 2026-11-04) since it's under dispute, and it's still marked approved but unpaid.
